lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: prabh sa(n)g mileejai ihu man deejai || naanak naam milai apanee daiaa karahu ||2||1||150||
lines.translation: He is blended with God, by dedicating his mind to Him. Bless Nanak with Your Name, O Lord - please, shower Your Mercy upon him! ||2||1||150||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil raam piaare tum bin dheeraj ko na karai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please, come to me, O Beloved Lord; without You, no one can comfort me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: si(n)mrit saasatr bahu karam kamaae prabh tumare daras bin sukh naahee ||1||
lines.translation: One may read the Simritees and the Shaastras, and perform all sorts of religious rituals; and yet, without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, God, there is no peace at all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: varat nem sa(n)jam kar thaake naanak saadh saran prabh sa(n)g vasai ||2||2||151||
lines.translation: People have grown weary of observing fasts, vows and rigorous self-discipline; Nanak abides with God, in the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||2||2||151||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 15 paRataal ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Fifteenth House, Partaal:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਦਿ ਸੋਇਓ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikaar maaiaa maad soio soojh boojh na aavai ||
lines.translation: He sleeps, intoxicated by corruption and Maya; he does not come to realize or understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਕਰਿ ਕੇਸ ਜਮਿ ਉਠਾਰਿਓ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pakar kes jam uthaario tad hee ghar jaavai ||1||
lines.translation: Seizing him by the hair, the Messenger of Death pulls him up; then, he comes to his senses. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਿਰਿ ਵਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਦੁਖਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobh bikhiaa bikhai laage hir vit chit dukhaahee ||
lines.translation: Those who are attached to the poison of greed and sin grab at the wealth of others; they only bring pain on themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗੁਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਸੁਰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin bha(n)gunaa kai maan maate asur jaanahi naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They are intoxicated by their pride in those things which shall be destroyed in an instant; those demons do not understand. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਸੁਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed saasatr jan pukaarahi sunai naahee doraa ||
lines.translation: The Vedas, the Shaastras and the holy men proclaim it, but the deaf do not hear it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਪਟਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰਿ ਮੂਕਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nipat baajee haar mookaa pachhutaaio man bhoraa ||2||
lines.translation: When the game of life is over, and he has lost, and he breathes his last, then the fool regrets and repents in his mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਗੈਰ ਵਜਹਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਦੀਵਾਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: daan sagal gair vajahi bhariaa deevaan lekhai na pariaa ||
lines.translation: He paid the fine, but it is in vain - in the Court of the Lord, his account is not credited.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਂਹ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਓਲੑਾ ਸੋਇ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je(n)h kaaraj rahai olhaa soi kaam na kariaa ||3||
lines.translation: Those deeds which would have covered him - those deeds, he has not done. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aiso jag mohi gur dikhaaio tau ek keerat gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru has shown me the world to be thus; I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: maan taan taj siaanap saran naanak aaiaa ||4||1||152||
lines.translation: Renouncing his pride in strength and cleverness, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||1||152||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਪਾਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: baapaar govi(n)d naae ||
lines.translation: Dealing in the Name of the Lord of the Universe,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਨਾਦ ਤੂਰ ਬਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh sa(n)t manaae pri paae gun gaae pa(n)ch naad toor bajaae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and pleasing the Saints and holy men, obtain the Beloved Lord and sing His Glorious Praises; play the sound current of the Naad with the five instruments. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਦਰਸਾਏ ਅਬ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa paae sahajaae darasaae ab raatiaa govi(n)d siu ||
lines.translation: Obtaining His Mercy, I easily gained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; now, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਥ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sev preet naath ra(n)g laalan laae ||1||
lines.translation: Serving the Saints, I feel love and affection for my Beloved Lord Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਹਸਾਏ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan man driRaae rahasaae nahee aae sahajaae man nidhaan paae ||
lines.translation: The Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within my mind, and I rejoice that I shall not have to come back again. I have obtained celestial poise, and the treasure within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤਜੀ ਮਨੈ ਕੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh tajee manai kee kaam karaa ||
lines.translation: I have renounced all of the affairs of my mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chir chir chir chir bhaiaa man bahut piaas laagee ||
lines.translation: It has been so long, so long, so long, so very long, since my mind has felt such a great thirst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har darasano dikhaavahu mohi tum bataavahu ||
lines.translation: Please, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, and show Yourself to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak deen saran aae gal laae ||2||2||153||
lines.translation: Nanak the meek has entered Your Sanctuary; please, take me in Your embrace. ||2||2||153||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ ਤੋਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooo bikham gaar torai ||
lines.translation: Who can destroy the fortress of sin,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਧੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aas piaas dhoh moh bharam hee te horai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and release me from hope, thirst, deception, attachment and doubt? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਾਨ ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਛੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh maan ih biaadh chhorai ||1||
lines.translation: How can I escape the afflictions of sexual desire, anger, greed and pride? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g naam ra(n)g gun govi(n)d gaavau ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, love the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadino prabh dhiaavau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, meditate on God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bheet jeet mitaavau ||
lines.translation: I have captured and demolished the walls of doubt.

lines.transliteration: nidh naam naanak morai ||2||3||154||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam is my only treasure. ||2||3||154||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh tiaag ||
lines.translation: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: man simar gobi(n)d naam ||
lines.translation: remember the Name of the Lord of the Universe in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਸਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhajan saphal kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditation on the Lord is the only fruitful action. ||1||Pause||
